title: Regional Data Constraints Intake & Vendor Questionnaire Triage Rubric
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Create a deterministic, auditable intake rubric and routing playbook for security & compliance asks coming from enterprise prospects and customers (SOC2/ISO attestations, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA clauses, vendor questionnaires). The rubric must enable fast first-response triage, clear routing to Legal/Security/Engineering/Compliance, and a documented exception path for urgent sales-led requests. Background: current intake is ad-hoc: SEs and AMs copy docs into Slack and pull Security/Legal into threads which causes delays and repeated evidence requests. This ticket will define the scoring criteria, thresholds, required evidence bundles by path, and a lightweight automation spec to embed into the intake form (Salesforce/HubSpot + Zendesk/Confluence link) and the Console intake API. Deliverables: 1) Scoring rubric spreadsheet (CSV) with weights, thresholds and example mappings 2) Intake form template with required file checklist per route 3) Routing rules for automatic assignment and SLA commitments 4) Playbook doc for customer-facing AMs + internal runbook for Security/Legal reviewers 5) Pilot with 3 enterprise accounts and measurement plan.
acceptance_criteria: Rubric spreadsheet with >=5 scored dimensions and example customer cases
Automated routing rules documented and implementable by infra/ops (example rule configs provided)
Intake form template validated by Sales, Legal, and Security
Pilot completed with 3 customers and SLA violation < 10% for first response in pilot
Playbook published to Confluence and linked from Zendesk templates
proposed_rubric: Score dimensions (suggested and weighted): Business Impact (0-5, weight 30%) — revenue at risk / go-live blocker
Compliance Severity (0-5, weight 30%) — regulatory scope (HIPAA > GDPR > SOC2 advisory)
Technical Complexity (0-5, weight 20%) — engineering effort to satisfy request (config, infra, data flow)
Data Residency Scope (0-5, weight 10%) — cross-border data movement or regional restrictions
Evidence Availability (0-5, weight 10%) — whether artifacts (certs, logs) already exist or require audits
Routing thresholds: 0-1 = self-serve (docs), 2-3 = AM + Security review within 5 business days, 4-5 = immediate Legal + Security escalation (SLA: 72 hours first response)
Urgency override: Sales can flag a request as 'sales-critical' which moves it into a monitored 48-hour lane but requires written justification and CSM sign-off
rollout_plan: Week 1: Draft rubric and intake template; get alignment from Security ops and Legal on thresholds
Week 2: Build intake form (Zendesk/Confluence + Console API sample) and automated routing rules spec; share with Sales for feedback
Week 3: Pilot with 3 mid-size enterprise deals (Sales, CSM, Security reviewers involved); collect metrics (TTR, rework)
Week 4: Iterate rubric and publish playbook; create training slide deck and short walkthrough video for AMs
Post-pilot: Bake routing rules into Console intake endpoint and add instrumentation for SLA dashboards
